mapping_json.fidelity_notes: AILMENT MARK-AND-CONSUME kit. Eras 3.19;3.20+ POST-ERRATA (verify_ledger: era claim CONTRADICTED, errata applied -- introduced 3.19.0 Lake of Kalandra; corpus row is post-errata truth). Both halves of the pair live IN-KIT (Orb of Storms applies, Conduit consumes) -> trigger_chain_shape=apply-consume-pair with on-mark-consume/consume-mark as the identity-bearing modeled step (b04 hexblast precedent for consume-side encoding; GC-mines precedent for in-kit pairs) -- DEPTH-1. The mark is the AILMENT ITSELF (sunder), not a separate marker. RESONANCE_LOOP door: verified Layer-2 is trigger=SEQUENCE, magnitude=THRESHOLD_BURST -- exactly the apply-then-cash-in sequence shape; ELEMENTAL_ECHO mono-lightning. Mechanical convergence note: engine sunder is a damage-taken-amp window, so a Conduit-analog hit both BENEFITS from and then clears the amp -- structurally close to source behavior. The magnitude COUPLING (more damage per 5% consumed shock effect) has no enum carrier; noted.
